C1.evidence: For N=20–80, DMRG energies match free-fermion to ~1e-11 relative; 1/N extrapolated e0 = -1.2731397 vs -4/pi = -1.2732395 (Δ≈1.0e-4).
C1.justification: Finite-N DMRG reproduces exact free-fermion energies to machine precision and extrapolates within 1e-4 of the thermodynamic limit.

C2.evidence: Fits yield c≈0.533 (N=32), 0.517 (N=64), 0.505 (N=128), trending to 0.5; ED at N=16 gives c≈0.544; one auxiliary diagnostic misfit reported c≈0.746.
C2.justification: Block entanglement scales with slope consistent with c→0.5 across increasing N, with one ancillary misfit likely due to a fitting/setup variant.

C3.justification: MPS is brought to canonical form to machine precision and Schmidt-value truncation achieves the predicted globally optimal 2-norm error.

C4.evidence: Imaginary-time TEBD (N=64, χ=32) yields e/site = -1.26754308 vs exact -1.26759344 (Δ≈5.0e-05), approaching -4/π in the large-N limit.
C4.justification: TEBD drives a product state to near-ground state with per-site energy matching DMRG/free-fermion within 5×10⁻⁵ for N=64.
